name: 013_no_false_contradiction
description: Topically similar but semantically compatible facts must NOT be treated as contradictions.

episodes.text:
User: I use Python for data science tasks.
Assistant: Great for that use case.

User: I also use Python for scripting and automation.
Assistant: Python is very versatile.

User: And I use Python for building backend APIs with FastAPI.
Assistant: FastAPI is excellent.

planted_facts: User uses Python for data science
User uses Python for scripting and automation
User uses Python for backend APIs
